text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High KV-cache continuous-batch growth detected. Models: mistral-v2, qwen-7b-m. p95 token latency > 1200ms, request error rate 4.8% over the last 3m. Backpressure observed on contbatch queues. Auto-throttle attempted but ineffective. Tagging oncall.

oncall-amy: Paging @eng-sre-raj. I'm seeing customer tickets come in about timeouts. Anyone available to triage?

eng-sre-raj: I'm on it. Initial look: KV cache cardinality exploded after a recent canary rollback for a batching tweak. Prefetch multiplier jumped to ~300 for some shards (should be ~16). Continuous-batch queues holding large prefixes -> massive evictions and OOMs on a subset of workers. grabbing logs now.

eng-sre-raj: Logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T03:21:10Z shard-42 contbatch: queue_len=12k prefetch_multiplier=312 kvcache_size=7.2GB evictions=1423 OOMs=3
2026-03-15T03:21:12Z model-mistral-v2 token_process_time=1.26s p95
```

eng-runtime-oliver: Probably the rollback left an old config key (legacy `batching.prefetch_factor`) that translates to multiplier*10. Quick mitigation options:
- hotpatch continuous-batch config to reduce prefetch on affected models
- temporarily disable contbatch for mistral-v2 and qwen-7b-m
- set stricter `batch_max_tokens` and `max_batch_size`

I suggest hotpatch first to avoid full restarts.

eng-runtime-oliver: Hotpatch payload (apply to affected shard group):
```
{
  "model_filter": ["mistral-v2","qwen-7b-m"],
  "continuous_batch": {
    "enabled": false,
    "prefetch_multiplier": 16,
    "batch_max_tokens": 512,
    "max_batch_size": 8
  }
}
```

Command to apply (I've tested dry-run):
```
redwoodctl config apply --target shards:kv-contbatch-*-prod --patch-file hotpatch.json --dry-run=false
```

support-lina: FYI support: AcmeCorp (acct: acme-enterprise) and Boxon reported ~10-15s timeouts; CS tickets created #CS-4521 and #CS-4523. I'll update with customer impact estimates after mitigation.

eng-sre-raj: Applying hotpatch now. @deploy-bot kick-off.

deploy-bot: Hotpatch job started by eng-sre-raj. Targets: kv-contbatch-prod-0..8. Rolling apply across shards.

deploy-bot: [shard-2] apply OK

deploy-bot: [shard-3] apply OK

deploy-bot: [shard-4] apply FAILED (worker oom) -> skipping to next shard, alerting SRE

eng-sre-raj: For the failed shard I'm doing a quick worker drain and restart, then reapply patch.

eng-sre-raj: Exec logs:
```
kubectl exec -n runtime runtime-shard-4 -- /bin/sh -c "kill -SIGTERM $(cat /var/run/worker.pid) && sleep 15 && systemctl start runtime-worker"
# wait
redwoodctl config apply --target shard-4 --patch-file hotpatch.json
Result: OK
```

prod-observability-bot: Metrics snapshot pre/post hotpatch:
- global p95 request latency: 1240ms -> 220ms
- error rate: 4.8% -> 0.6%
- KV eviction rate: 1423/5m -> 28/5m
- contbatch queue length (affected shards): 12k -> 90

eng-ml-sara: Longer-term model-specific mitigation proposal: route MQA workload with high prefix-cardinality to the GQA-mix variant or lighter Llama fallbacks when prefix length distribution exceeds threshold, and add per-model prefetch caps. I'll open a design RFC.

support-lina: Customer update: AcmeCorp and Boxon have been notified that mitigation is in place; CS tickets updated. Both report improved behavior. No escalations at exec level.

incident-bot: :pager: If this resurfaces within 30m, escalate to @eng-platform for deeper routing/fallback changes. Also scheduling automatic rolling back of the legacy `batching.prefetch_factor` translator to avoid reintroducing bug.

oncall-amy: Handing this off to follow-up shift. Summary for next-oncall:
- cause: mis-translated config key after rollback -> prefetch multiplier amplified
- mitigation: hotpatch disable/limit contbatch on affected models; restart one OOMed worker
- customer impact: transient timeouts for ~7% of traffic affecting two large customers (CS tickets open)
- next steps: eng-ml to submit RFC for per-model caps; eng-runtime to add detection alert for prefetch_multiplier > 32; postmortem scheduled 2026-03-15T06:00:00Z in #incidents

customer-success-mateo: I'll send an outbound note to the two customers after postmortem draft is available. Will include timeline and mitigation details. :eyes:

eng-sre-raj: Adding follow-up action items to the incident tracker: INCIDENT-3247. Will also add a throttling rule to observability alerts (prefetch_multiplier > 32 -> SEV2).

oncall-amy: Thanks everyone. Closing live mitigation. Keep watch for related alerts. :thumbsup:
